ظَيْبَهٌ وَكُوبٌ also An antelope that keeps to its herd. (TA.) ―
-b2- ظَيْبَهٌ وَكُوبٌ An antelope proceeding at a quick pace, with long steps; syn. التّى تُعْنِقُ فى سَيْرِهَا: (S:) and in like manner ↓ نَاقَةٌ مُوَاكِبَهٌ a she-camel that proceeds in that manner: (S, K:) see وَكَبَ: or the latter signifies a she-camel that journeys, or marches, or keeps pace, with the مَوْكِب: (K:) that does not lag behind the [company of] riders. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
